Sprint 997 EUR + Plus-Plus 4.797 EUR + leader_os_plus_3rate (3×1.599=4.797) all in PACKAGES with correct mode/cycles. No 4447 anywhere in PACKAGES/PLAN_AMOUNT_MAP. License key flow: /api/license/create returns LEADEROS-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX, /api/license/activate returns redirect_url='https://leaderos.de'. Lines 19-21 still show 'Layer 1: AI Literacy / Layer 2: Real-World Rhetoric / Layer 3: Strategic EQ' subtitles. User explicitly asked: no 'Layer 1/2/3' jargon in Wlad-Sprache. Replace subtitles with simpler labels (e.g., '01 · KI im Alltag').

'Boardroom-Rhetorik' jargon still appears in many places. User said remove this term in favor of simple Wlad-Sprache (e.g., just 'Rhetorik' or 'Klare Worte'). Homepage hero already uses 'Rhetorik' badge (good). Sweep remaining occurrences for consistency.
Heading 'Leadership OS Enterprise · Rabatt-Rechner' still uses legacy brand 'Leadership OS'. Should be 'Sprint Enterprise · Rabatt-Rechner' or 'Leader OS Enterprise'.

critical_code_review_comments: pricing.py is a clean single-source-of-truth — PACKAGES + PLAN_AMOUNT_MAP both reflect 4797.0 for leader_os_plus; the new leader_os_plus_3rate is correctly structured as a subscription with total_amount=4797, amount=1599, cycles=3, interval=month. Frontend pricingConstants.js is in sync.

Stripe subscription path (_create_subscription_session) uses cents (unit_amount=int(amount*100)) while one-time path via emergentintegrations uses EUR major units (no *100) — both are correct per their respective SDK contracts and have clear comments. Iter27 regression test prevents the *100 bug from returning.
Defense-in-depth amount guard (1≤charge_amount≤100000 in _create_one_time_session) catches both cents-bug (would be ~479700) and 0.01 typos. Good.

_handle_paid_webhook hard-codes 997 fallback for tx amount in payment email — if a Plus-Plus customer's tx record somehow loses its amount field, they'd get a 997 EUR confirmation email. Minor edge case but worth tracking.

Frontend testids are excellent on /close: close-final-os, close-final-os-plus, plan-leader-os, plan-leader-os-plus, price-leader-os, price-leader-os-plus, cta-leader-os, cta-leader-os-plus, comparison — fully testable.

Report.jsx CTAs (lines 518, 526) are inside the main report content block which only renders when localStorage 'emergent_report' is present. Without seeded report data, /report falls back to the Hero (visible in test: body starts with 'Entdecke, welche Führungsrolle…'). Consider rendering at least the scarcity bar + CTAs even in the empty-report fallback so cold-traffic visitors to /report see conversion paths.

/roadmap journal-gate is state-only (useState entries array, not localStorage), so it cannot be bypassed via localStorage prefill. After typing in all 6 textareas filledCount becomes 6 and both CTAs render correctly — verified live.
Comparison table component uses tailwind text-white/text-[#C8FF00]/text-slate-500 — PLUS-PLUS header is lime-green to highlight the recommended tier. Good contrast.
